events.implied_move_method: ATM straddle mid (nearest-strike call+put) / spot, on the first listed expiry that captures the report (BMO: expiry >= report date; AMC/TNS: expiry >= next day). The straddle also prices all volatility until that expiry, so a distant expiry overstates the event move.
